meta.name: code-review
meta.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes — Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/PRD asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照规范和需求审查代码变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在合并代码前确保它既符合规范又满足需求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes against standards and specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure code changes meet both coding standards and requirements before merging.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会并行检查代码变更的两个方面：是否符合仓库的编码标准，以及是否实现了原始需求（如 Issue 或 PRD）。最终并排输出两份报告。
howto.when: 当你要求审查一个分支、PR、工作区变更，或说“审查自 X 以来的变更”时触发。需要你提供一个固定点（如 commit、分支、标签）。

say.text: 审查这个分支自 main 以来的变更
审查自 HEAD~3 以来的代码
审查这个 PR 的代码
say.note: Claude 会识别 PR 的变更范围，进行双轴审查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will review code changes along two axes in parallel: whether the code follows the repo's documented coding standards, and whether it matches the originating issue/PRD. It outputs two reports side by side.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review a branch, PR, work-in-progress changes, or say "review since X". You need to supply a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, etc.).

say_en.text: Review changes on this branch since main
say_en.note: Claude compares current branch with main, checks standards and spec.
Claude compares last 3 commits and outputs two reports.
Claude identifies the PR's diff and performs a two-axis review.
